get.description:
The table. A search also asks the search providers, on its first page, for papers the
collection lacks: the `outside` band. Topic and saved belong to the collection, so with
either filter set there is no outside band; `source` keeps one band only.

put.description:
The owner names the published version by DBLP key or DOI, or says there is none.
A lookup never overwrites it. A DOI DBLP does not know is kept with the arXiv entry.

schema.title: Response Set Publication Api Papers  Paper Id  Publication Put

delete.description: Drop the stored version, the owner's choice included; the paper is looked up again.

post.description:
BibTeX for chosen papers. One paper is looked up first, so a copied entry cites the
published version as soon as DBLP has it; several use what is stored. `cited` are
papers a search provider found outside the collection: they get arXiv entries from
what the hit carries, with no fetch, no lookup and nothing written.

get.description: BibTeX for every paper the table's filter matches.

post.description: Find a paper by arXiv id or link, fetching it when the collection lacks it.

get.description: A Radar or Pulse topic's reviews, newest first, shown above its picks.

schema.title: Response Topic Reviews Api Topics  Slug  Reviews Get

put.description: The label row on a paper page: the owner's own word, origin `reader`.

The paper matters for the field: it joins the library, gets a thumb up for the
field, and becomes a member as the owner's own addition, which the field's next review
sees and its page lists as added by the owner. Never a Watch miss.

delete.description:
Take it back: the owner's membership and the thumb go; the library is left as it is,
since the Save toggle is the owner's word on that.

post.description: File a miss for a Watch topic. The trace of what each stage said runs afterwards.

schema.title: Response Topics Api Settings Topics Get

put.description:
Create or edit a topic. Edits apply forward; a change of kind or content settles the
topic's papers again (see feedback.word.settle_topic).

The owner's order: sections, cards and the Papers table's take column follow it. The
list must name every topic once. Rows are locked as a topic save locks them.

get.description:
How many stored papers each keyword pattern matches, as the keyword audit matches:
the topic's saved patterns, or the `pattern`s given (an editor's unsaved draft). A
pattern that is not a valid regular expression counts -1.

schema.title: Response Keywords Api Settings Topics  Slug  Keywords Get

post.description:
Run a draft of the topic over its labelled papers and misses, as a dry run. Returns at
once; the evaluation's metrics appear under /evaluations/{id} when it finishes.

get.description: At the top, what last night left; below, how well the Watch topics are doing.

get.description:
One card per loaded integration, then one per configured section that is turned off
(its cursor kept, so its lag shows what turning it on again would hand it).

schema.title: Response Status Api Settings Integrations Get

post.description: Try the failing event again now, without waiting out its backoff.

Give up on the failing event; the integration goes on with the next. Returns the
event skipped. `event_id` names the event the owner confirmed: when another one is
failing by then, nothing is skipped (409).

get.description:
The outbox in order, from after a position: for a client that polls instead of taking
webhooks. Start without `after`, then pass the `next` of each answer to read on. Only
events whose transactions are settled are listed, so reading on never misses one that
committed late.

post.description:
Ask for a deep card on this paper, whatever its grade. Honoured by whichever loaded
integration answers `card.requested`; the card shows on the paper once it is stored.
Exchange the token for the cookie the web app then rides on.

Ack.title: Ack
Ack.description: What happened, in the words the reader sees.

Answer.title: Answer
Answer.description: One paper's answers. Fit for the topic it was drawn or taken for is required.

BibtexFilter.title: BibtexFilter
BibtexFilter.description: A papers-table filter, as `GET /api/papers` takes it.

Cadence.title: Cadence
Cadence.description:
How often a Radar or Pulse topic is reviewed. Weekly always; daily adds a review after
each nightly run, for a Radar field followed closely.

Changes.title: Changes
Changes.description: A page of the changes feed, and the position to read on from.

Chosen.title: Chosen
Chosen.description: The folded "how this was chosen" for one Watch topic.

CitedIn.title: CitedIn
CitedIn.description: A paper outside the collection, as a search hit gives it: enough for an arXiv entry.

DeepCard.title: DeepCard
DeepCard.description: A deep card: the reading card the deep service wrote, as it wrote it.

Digest.title: Digest
Digest.description: The feed: daily issues newest first, and the week's weekly issue pinned above them.

Entry.title: Entry
Entry.description: One paper in an issue, for one Watch topic.

Event.title: Event
Event.description: A fact written to the outbox in the same transaction as the data it describes.

Failing.title: Failing
Failing.description: The event an integration is stuck on; its later events wait behind it.

Grade.title: Grade
Grade.description: A Watch topic's judgement of a paper, most inclusive first.

Hand.title: Hand
Hand.description: The owner's newest use of the Save toggle.

Label.title: Label
Label.description: The owner's word on one paper for one Watch topic. It outranks any verdict.

LabelOrigin.title: LabelOrigin
LabelOrigin.description:
How the labelled paper was chosen, which decides what its label can be evidence for.

A label keeps the origin it was created with when the owner later changes its value, so a
change of mind never moves a paper out of the sample it was drawn in.

Listed.title: Listed
Listed.description: A paper named in a recap, with the owner's thumb on it for the recap's topic.

PaperTopic.title: PaperTopic
PaperTopic.description: The paper as one topic sees it.

Papers.title: Papers
Papers.description:
A page of the table. A search also brings the papers search providers found that the
collection lacks, as a second band under the first; a provider that failed or was too
slow is named in `left_out`.

Pick.title: Pick
Pick.description: A paper a review picked, with its sentence on why.

Publication.title: Publication
Publication.description: The published record of a paper: what a BibTeX entry needs, as DBLP has it.

PublicationIn.title: PublicationIn
PublicationIn.description: The owner's correction: a DBLP key, a DOI, or that there is no published version.

Recap.title: Recap
Recap.description:
A Watch topic's week: prose over its entries, then the entries as one-liners, what
the owner set aside and the misses reported.

Review.title: Review
Review.description:
A Radar or Pulse topic's review of a day or a week. A failed one says so in one line;
a quiet one had no papers to read.

ScheduleOut.title: ScheduleOut
ScheduleOut.description:
The schedule as the Runs page shows it: whether it is on, the zone the cron times are
read in, and when each job next fires (or would, if it were on).

SearchStats.title: SearchStats
SearchStats.description: How a search provider has answered since the service started.

Topic.title: Topic
Topic.description: Something the owner follows. `revision` is set by the store when the topic is saved.

TopicKind.title: TopicKind
TopicKind.description: The service a topic gets: graded per paper, reviewed weekly, or summarised weekly.

litwatch__api__schemas__Status.title: Status
litwatch__api__schemas__Status.description: The printer's line under the masthead.
